install_msg: `/roasttoast` or `/roasttoast @user` — then Roast, Toast, Surprise, or Another Round.
name: roasttoast
description: Interactive café-themed roast and toast generator. Optional target member; buttons for Roast, Toast, Surprise, and Another Round. Playful, not cruel. No persistence.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
